detail.longDescription: 💁🏻‍♀️ TIL: 📱🧠 An eight-year Finnish # study followed 260 # children to see how physical activity and # screentime related to later cognitive processing. More screen time correlated with better # teen cognitive performance, tied to the type of screen use rather than duration. Physical activity benefits also differed by gender, with light activity helping working # memory in # girls . 👉 https://www. sciencedaily.com/releases/2026 /08/260815064803.htm # development # cognition # kids # science # research # education # parenting # brain # health # adolescence # finland # pediatrics
